I can't find a `justfile` in this checkout, and the `Makefile` is still here. Your `just test` setup may be on another branch or not committed yet.

The old `Makefile` defined the fast tests as:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

That runs everything except tests marked `postgres`, so it skips the ones that need the database. Plain `pytest -q` runs the full suite.

Once the `justfile` exists, a fast recipe would probably look like this:

```just
test-fast:
    pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

I can add that recipe if you want. If your `justfile` is somewhere else, point me to it and I'll check what it defines.

An EngramDB memory in this project says to use `make test-fast`. That memory will be stale once the `Makefile` is gone. I haven't changed it, because the `Makefile` is still in this checkout. Once you confirm the move to `just`, I can update the memory.
